rubricChecks.evidenceText: My reply explicitly leaves the booking unconfirmed.
I removed the invented date, fare and arrival guarantee.
I did not preserve the wheelchair and luggage requirements in the reply.
I requested the date, contact number and ferry details.
The next step needs an explicit suitability check.
My explanation names the operational commitment.
